function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

Here’s a quick snapshot of the **next big festival in the United States** (as of today, August 6 2026) and a few other major events that are coming up in the next few weeks/months.  

| Festival | Dates (2026) | Location | What to Expect | Quick Link |
|----------|--------------|----------|----------------|------------|
| **Summerfest** | **Aug 12 – Aug 20** | Milwaukee, WI | 8‑day music extravaganza featuring 200+ acts across 12 stages, food trucks, craft beer, and a huge “Summerfest Village” with games and activities. | <https://www.summerfest.com> |
| **Lollapalooza Chicago** | **Aug 18 – Aug 21** | Chicago, IL | 4‑night festival with top‑tier rock, hip‑hop, indie, and electronic acts. 12 stages, art installations, and a dedicated kids’ zone. | <https://www.lollapalooza.com> |
| **New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival** | **Oct 7 – Oct 16** | New Orleans, LA | Classic New‑Orleans vibe: jazz, blues, zydeco, world music, and a huge food & drink scene. 10 stages, 200+ performers. | <https://www.nojazzfest.com> |
| **Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival** | **Oct 14 – Oct 22** | Indio, CA | Iconic 8‑day festival with a mix of mainstream and indie acts, art installations, and a massive “Coachella Village.” | <https://www.coachella.com> |
| **Burning Man** | **Oct 25 – Nov 4** | Black Rock Desert, NV | Not a traditional music festival, but a massive art & community event featuring large-scale installations, music, and a “Burning Man” ceremony. | <https://burningman.org> |

### Why Summerfest is the “next” festival
- **Timing**: It starts just 6 days from today (Aug 12) and runs for a full week.
- **Scale**: It’s the world’s largest music festival by attendance, drawing over 800,000 people each year.
- **Accessibility**: Milwaukee is a major city with plenty of hotels, transportation options, and a vibrant downtown.

### Quick Tips if you’re planning to attend
1. **Book early** – Tickets for Summerfest sell out fast; consider buying a “Summerfest Pass” for unlimited stage access.
2. **Plan your lodging** – Look for hotels or Airbnb listings in the “Summerfest Village” area for the best experience.
3. **Check the lineup** – The official site updates the artist roster weekly; you can also download the festival app for real‑time schedules.
4. **Weather prep** – Milwaukee in mid‑August can be hot and humid. Pack light clothing, sunscreen, and a reusable water bottle.

---

#### Want more details on a specific festival or a different type (food, cultural, etc.)?  
Just let me know, and I can dive deeper into line‑ups, ticket pricing, travel tips, or even pull up the latest weather forecast for the festival location using the Open‑Meteo API.
